Multiply outside coefficients first; combine radicands only when nonnegative. For conjugates use (a+b)(a-b)=a²-b². Check variable domains and absolute values before simplifying.
For a,b≥0, sqrt(a)sqrt(b)=sqrt(ab). Simplify square factors; distribute through brackets; conjugates produce differences of squares. For real x, sqrt(x²)=|x|.
